summary: Component (Vitest nuxt) tests for the Phase-3 trigger selector + EMIT_EVENT step. All 7 TDD-anchor behaviors covered with real DOM/model/emit assertions. Mocking limited to useApi + useRoute (the established SearchableSelect pattern, under the 3+ wrong-test-type threshold). Test pyramid correct: tech-spec assigns no E2E here, covers via Vitest component tests. 402/402 frontend tests green.

findings.finding: All seven task TDD anchors covered: keyword editor render + on_start-block hidden, tag/field SearchableSelect render, api-event slug invalid->error + valid->clears, keyword add(2)/remove(1) model equality, on_start deep-link no-regression, EMIT_EVENT in picker + event-name field, EMIT_EVENT emit {stepType,eventName} + block-on-empty.

keyword add/remove asserts the actual `keywords` model array (['bonus','sale'] then ['sale']) via the manual v-model handler pattern — verifies real state mutation through the emitted update contract, not a mock call.
The page-level persist() branching (keyword owns `keywords` + clears triggerValue; other types own triggerValue + clear keywords — the stale-value Edge case) is not asserted in funnel-editor.spec.ts.
findings.reason: tech-spec scopes Vitest to the three component behaviors (selector, keyword list, EMIT_EVENT) — all covered. The PATCH round-trip is explicitly a verify-user (human / Task 15) check per the task's Verify-user. Adding a page-PATCH assertion would exceed the stated automated-test scope; flagged for transparency.
